text: Free CI: clean install and pnpm check on every push (GitHub Actions)
description: No CI exists; the first-run test failure fixed in 0ee4507 went unnoticed until a manual clean clone. GitHub Actions is free for public repositories on standard runners, so this costs nothing while the repo stays public. Workflow: checkout, pnpm install (cache the pnpm store and the embedding model), pnpm check. Keep it to one job; no deploys, no secrets.
